assumptions: The auto-checkpoint git hook committed exactly the files I staged with git add (no sweep of untracked sibling files) — verified by git show --stat HEAD showing only the reader_study_full_analysis.py line addition I intended.

disconfirmation: If browsing https://github.com/junjslee/neonatal-ai-reliability after the push reveals any of: (a) a .tiff or .tif file in /figures/, (b) any content from /_archive/, (c) a Co-Authored-By trailer in commits 5aa4ca9 or 3e800a4, (d) reader-level data CSVs in /quantitative_analysis/ — the publish-safety audit was wrong and the affected commits must be reverted before downstream readers cache them.
